win_system.notes:
WAYS TO WIN

 The specified requirements for a winning combination in the base game are also used during bonus features or free spins play unless otherwise stated. Each wager is eligible for all winning combinations unless otherwise stated.

 Land 5 or more connecting symbols of the same kind anywhere on the grid to get a winning combination.

scatters.name: COCKTAIL GLASS SYMBOL
scatters.behavior:
When a winning combination appears while the Cocktail Glass scatter symbol is on the grid, all symbols of the winning type are re-frozen to the fully frozen state. More than one symbol type can be re-frozen at the same time.

 The number on the Cocktail Glass shows the number of remaining re-freezes that can occur, which starts at a maximum of 5. The Cocktail Glass is removed on the next symbol removal after the last re-freeze.

scatters.name: BLENDER SYMBOL
scatters.behavior:
When the Blender scatter symbol lands it activates and chooses one type of symbol to absorb.

 All symbols of the chosen type are absorbed by the Blender and new symbols drop in to replace them. This continues until there are no more symbols of the chosen type.

 At the end of the spin the Blender will award a prize equivalent to a cluster of the absorbed amount of symbols. Please refer to the paytable to see the possible awards for different cluster sizes. The Blender always starts with a count of 2 symbols and adds 1 to its counter for each absorbed symbol.

specials.name: FROZEN SYMBOLS
specials.behavior:
All paying symbols have one of three states: fully frozen, half-frozen or unfrozen.

 Every time that a winning combination is awarded, the unfrozen symbols that were part of that winning combination are removed. After all winning combinations have been awarded, all unfrozen symbols on the grid are removed regardless of whether they were part of a winning combination or not.

 Symbols that are fully frozen or half-frozen are not removed from the grid, even if they were part of a winning combination.

 Symbols that were not removed instead change state: symbols that were fully frozen become half-frozen and symbols that were half-frozen become unfrozen.

 New symbols then drop in to replace the removed symbols. This continues until there are no more winning combinations on the grid.

modes.name: SUNSET PICNIC BONUS GAME
modes.effects:
Picnic Basket scatter symbols that land during a base game round are collected in the meter next to the grid.

 If a total of 3 Picnic Basket symbols land in the same base game round, the Sunset Picnic bonus feature is activated and awards 9 - 15 free spins. Each Picnic Basket symbol will reveal a number from 3 to 5. The number of awarded free spins is equal to the sum of the revealed numbers.

 During this bonus feature there is a higher chance of landing the Cocktail Glass and Blender symbols.

 Landing additional Picnic Basket symbols during the feature awards 2 to 5 extra free spins per landed Picnic Basket.

 SPECIAL SYMBOLS

 A paying symbol’s frozen state does not affect the rules for creating winning combinations or the symbol’s payout levels. Please refer to the paytable for payout levels for each winning combination.
